contentList.content: Off
Hmph. If your mind is still so rigid after all it has suffered, there is little point in trying to change it.
'Visit as soon as I can?' Don't be an ass, Halsin. I'll come with you right now.
Player 1
Lae'zel could not have wished for a finer companion by her side. You truly love her, I can tell. Just keep each other safe, please.
Lady Shar's church flourishes - but with it comes a great deal of work. I am kept busy, leading her ever-growing flock.
I need you - but the city needs you more.
Whittled Duck
I'm joking. Of course I want to know - tell me all.
Whichever rodent chose this outfit must have thought its wearer looked very handsome in it.
Is it? We have experienced much together. Consider this an opportunity for further mutual exploration.
Those runes on the floor - the vampire lord feeds on his spawn like a leech.
Moon Druid
Coming from you, that's high praise. The continent ought to be flattered.
I'm sorry - I promised Lae'zel my aid in Faerûn. Godhood will have to wait.
Brazier
If only you could stay here with me on the Coast. But Karlach's heart needs you more than mine.
Of course not. I'm sure you only want what's best for Baldur's Gate, after all.
For one so fleshless of form, Withers is well-versed in the preparing of meat.

Why you little stinker! Good thing I plan for all eventualities - including the pup's untimely exit. That's the thing about devils: when someone goes knotting things up, we work out the kinks. (Yes, I'm only half-devil, but let's not quibble over details, dumpling.)

Suffice to say, plans have changed. I could've just flitted off without leaving a message, but I could NEVER be so rude - why, you were twice as fun as a pail of de-winged imps, and not near so ugly.

So... ta-ta. For now.

Mizora
I'll be sure to send an invitation.
Sweet cub. Rest up, and you can come with me in the morning, if you like?
The Book of Willing Souls
I dwell upon what we shared: that bond was forged in a crucible that can never be stoked again, Oak Father willing. It is a bond that can weather any distance, any passage of time.
Spores Druid
You don't control me. No one controls me. Accept that or don't.
Now that we can breathe a little, how about a hug?
Well you love animals, don't you? I thought you might like us to take in one. A rather large, feathered one.
What a wonder he is. He will be a fine warrior, if he chooses. Or a poet, or an explorer, or a scholar.
They may respect me or fear me, but I do not think they like me.

To my unlikely ally,

I must confess I was surprised to receive an invitation to your gathering, but not entirely displeased; though circumstances placed us on the same side once battle lines were drawn, you proved to be a most admirable instrument in bringing about the end to the Absolute. Nevertheless, I cannot step away from Lady Shar's sacred work. Please, raise a goblet on my behalf, and know that I shall gaze upon the very same umbral tapestry that you feast under.

Viconia DeVir

Mother Superior of the Cloister of Sombre Embrace

P.S. Our mutual acquaintance has settled back into her life of servitude very well, I am glad to report. Her mind is a blank slate, eager to learn of the Dark Lady's ways. I shall make something of her yet.
Gale
I suppose I could help a few young minds learn from my mistakes.
Dark Deliverance
I've found a calm life. Herbal tea, breathing exercises, stretches.
Thirteen kith'raki, twenty-five sarths, and three-hundred-five warriors. Precisely.

To the Mla'ghir who freed me. To Lae'zel, T'lak'ma Ghir. My words come to you on slate, for they are immutable and eternal.

You are not just liberators - you are all Warriors of the Comet, whatever land you travel, whatever sea you cross, whatever plane you grace.

Vlaakith's pawns fall, one by one, at the hands of my faithful. But the City of Death stands, and the Queen sits on her vile throne at its centre. But we stand at a precipice. Lae'zel: thanks to you, we are soon to restore an old kinship, and Vlaakith will burn in the fires thus stoked. The Protocols are written anew, and to you, Mla'ghir, I dedicate the First:

All who call themselves gith shall unite under one sky.

Gith'ka tavkim krash'ht.
Orpheus
Perhaps he has found a new Wychlaran, after all.
Saving Grace
My home is with Shadowheart.
But... I failed her.
Ngh... looking for attention, Shar? Pathetic.
Lae'zel, T'lak'ma Ghir - the devil holds the key to freeing the gith people. Right here, right now, you could seal our fate.
If only Orpheus could have shared in our victories.
Then I must go with the Prince. I will never be free while my people are still bound by Vlaakith's chains.
This 'Galerian' magic of yours sounds intriguing. Could I wield it as I do the Weave?

To an old acquaintance,

I write to you from the sunny porch of the Last Light Inn. A light breeze blows now and then. People are milling in and out - builders, visitors, the children of all ages in Halsin's care.

I can no longer hold a quill, or eat without assistance - a kind friend is transcribing this for me. Thaniel, re-joined with Oliver, has promised to be with me when the end comes, and as our old songs drift on the wind, ever louder, I know I have mere days left.

But I do not fear it. If not for your help, this land would still be shrouded in darkness, and I'd still be lost within it. Know that my heart is full and happy, and I am grateful for my last moments.

Do visit some day. And if you have time to stop by an old Flaming Fist's grave, I know I'd love to see you.

Art Cullagh

You know, I never really imagined Withers as much of a party-thrower, but then again I suppose our camps weren't taking care of themselves while we were out gallivanting, were they? There's hidden depths in that loveable husk.
You have been keeping busy! Boo is glad to hear a hero of your calibre has not been sitting idle.
Fucking Mizora. I bet you're glad to be rid of her.
Grotesque Distention
They should know of goings-on in the Gate. The rebuilding, the renewal... there's plenty to talk about.
Exactly what I feared. Without the protection of our little friends I was just an ordinary spawn again, burning in the sun. I fled the dock and found refuge in the shadows until night fell.
Tough gig?
We delivered the Zhentarim shipment to Baldur's Gate.
*An invitation to a celebration, for those who stood against the Netherbrain, those who thwarted the Grand Design.*
Until I know where I am, I can't decide.
Hardly - campaigning at Lae'zel's side against Vlaakith is no picnic. Makes me pine for the good old days.

Our community grows rapidly; in six months, we have turned what was once a shadowy wasteland into a true home for all. In another six months, I would wager the scars of the past will be entirely invisible even to those who remember them.
Oghma
Not even a whiff of fresh blood. You're such a damn tease.
So, if a certain warlock sought a more powerful patron - perhaps the Hagmother herself, you might help with that?
*Whyever not? After all, you are an illithid - whatever flaws plagued you as a human are long behind you now.*
*No respite shall be had at this pitiful smorgasbord.*
Hunting
Do you think I cannot sense you, spectre?
Two can play at that shit - let old Karlach step on and take a taste.
Then we will ascend to the Astral Plane together. Now focus your mind, hear my words. I will speak the Rite.
*Carve the blessing from it, your patron pleads, make it ours.*
You - you've no idea who I am. Withers couldn't even find a bard that knows who I am?
Our journey together granted me unprecedented clarity. I feel more connected to my Ki than ever.
Sent
It's been tough, keeping myself alive.
Channel your power as Vampire Ascendant and turn into a vampiric bat.
Are you joking? I've been counting down the days.
You can say that again. I've slept under the stars enough for one lifetime.
*For six months, Lae'zel has been learning the ways of Faerûn by your side, as you travelled together far and wide.*
I could hardly decline an invitation to reunite with my dearest companions.
Didn't know Withers could snag me at will. Wish he'd do it more often.
Crate A
Heh.
*You will triumph with a sword in your hand and a bow at your back. You don't need the Hells' gifts to be mighty.*
This from the man who wanted us to make love as gods? You must be at least curious...
Stop classes that cannot usually cast a spell using a spell scroll to cast it anyway.
Births, first loves, marriages, losses - I remember them all and always will. Each memory I've consumed is of value.
I've been seeing the world. And hiding from Cazador...
The war against Vlaakith is a bloody one, but there's talk of an alliance with the githzerai.
*An invitation, written in a frail hand, inviting you to a celebration for those who stood against the Absolute.*
Are you trying to be funny?
I hunt the Hells, ridding them of any beast that has set its eyes on the Sword Coast.
Have you quite forgotten what and who we are, kin?
I'm surprised you still recognised me.
*You feel a pang of divine guilt. Musical prayers went out of fashion among bards when Milil, Lord of Song, offended the god Cyric and was ejected from the pantheon.*
For two months Orpheus trained me in the ways of the Comet. For two more I skewered kith'raki bellies. And for two more yet I travelled through Limbo.
Well, you always did like the sound of your own voice.
And our little hatchling? Is he safe?
Scratch can fetch
Galerian Revelry
Pink Branch
Well, I shall be sure to let you know if I spot any.
*Withers, who raised you when your father struck you down. He bids you join him at a gathering of your allies and friends.*
Letter from Devella
All muscle, doll. Avernus isn't the sort of place you go to live off the fat of the land.
We already learned Gond's true name. Nebelun.
Then the architects of Baldur's Gate lack ambition. Had they grander vision, a greater city would rise from the ashes.
Divine Performance
We undid the Grand Design, and saved Baldur's Gate from annihilation.
Stop the ritual!
Dead? Burnt up?! But it was just a little tap to knock him out!
I've felt your gaze. Whenever a chill passes through me, I know Shar's favoured is close.
We shall conclude our business with the thief - but have no fear, my friend.
Alas, you can't.
I'm sorry for keeping you in suspense then. I've missed you.
Pet him.
You have a habit of getting captured - did you ever notice that?
His mind is forever lost. Come - he is no use to us, nor our queen.
Our issue would be perfect...
It is over...
You are right, of course. What we have made shall outgrow us both, and Oak Father willing, stand as our legacy...
They were our warships during the greatest eras of the Illithid Empire. We ruled the entire Astral Plane from their decks.
This may be the last time we come together. Make these moments count.
Our skeletal friend will be very pleased to see I found my way here, despite my invitation getting lost in the post.
Ahem.
Exactly what someone who tried to usurp a goddess would say...
Did you find the Crown of Karsus?
As if you'd have me any other way.
The past made present. I'm glad for it, for this.
Yes - let's see how I compare to the fierce flame that is Karlach!
Disintegrate
After the tug of war the gods have played for you, you want to flee to a secular order? Hah. I can see it.
Oh, I've seen every corner of the realms. I just know what I like.
Affected entity is controlled by Mystic Carrion until combat ends. When this affect ends, the entity will be destroyed.
I hope the others in the Underdark are behaving themselves without me.
Ambition, aspiration - greed and hubris is all I hear.
Aegis of the Absolute: Fire
I enjoyed my time in Baldur's Gate. It gave me a taste for more.
Goodbye for now, soldier. Until we meet again - whether you like it or not.
Tell me how you've been faring - you wanted to form a new settlement, didn't you?
Letter from Auntie Ethel
Anything else on your mind? I'm an open book - if a bit scorched at the edges.
Sounds like you've been keeping busy. Glad you have someone at your side all the way.
Don't worry. With the ambition you hold, you'll never be too far from my sights.
Stormheart Resolve
I shouldn't have let you go to Avernus without me. I should've gone with you.
Of course. We gave up so much.
But no more.
I will deliver to her the Prince of the Comet. She shall exalt me. The gish will record my great deed in slate!
A little wine might help accelerate the process...
Seems you've found your true calling. I envy you.
Wonderful! Lead on then.
Study them well, sneak-thief - for the best among them will be a guide for your Guild. Heroes, who put the city before themselves. Who never falter in their duty. And, more than this...
Nice little spot, isn't it?
Good to know I didn't disappear completely when I left. I won't lie - it's been hard.
Retributive Justice
You've been to Limbo? Does this mean you mean to ally with the githzerai?
At least I assume it's you in there. It is a little hard to tell.
You must know I miss you dearly, Tara.
Brittle
But if your senses ever grace you with their presence again and you wish to return to my side... I may consider your plea.
But you have chosen a path for yourself, and it does not lead to the Astral Plane.
I should snuff you out and make coin of your soul, but it will be more amusing to let you see the consequences of your actions.
Candle
Gale is his own man, Tara.
There you are. I was hoping you'd make your way over.
*He requested your attendance in Faerun, to gather with your friends and allies, those who stood against the Absolute at your side.*
I'm sure we could widen the door frame - imagine being able to cuddle an owlbear on a cold night.
Rest well friend. Thou deservest as much.
What honours, what riches, will the Undying Queen grant me when I hand her the failed prince?
You're just fretting - let life take its course.
Cazador was still out there, after all. But with a little help from my darling love, finding and destroying him barely took any effort at all.
It's a heavy burden, but a rewarding one. Rebuilding the city, helping it heal - it's been good.
They're your friends too.
I've found much to delight me in the Underdark. I think I'll be quite content there.
No, the urges have passed. I'm my own person again.
*A sharp pain - like your eye being carved out - washes over you as your patron borrows your vision momentarily.*
*The gathering will not be in the city that you saved though. It will be where your adventures first began.*
I fear there can be no victory in the war that has chosen us, but every moment we spend together is cause for celebration.
First - do you think you can bare to give me a hug?
And it looks like life at Shadowheart's side is suiting you...
It does.
Considering all you and Minsc have done, I think we'd be welcomed.
You cannot best me. You will die here, and your legacy will die with you.
I'm sure you could widen the door frame - imagine being able to cuddle an owlbear on a cold night.
Statue Base

My love,

Firstly - please forgive the scrawled nature of this note. My handwriting is no match for the Netherbrain's tremors. Or perhaps my hands shake of their own accord. At this juncture, it is difficult to tell.

Do not misunderstand me - I am not afraid to die. But I am afraid of what I might leave behind me. That my sacrifice might hurt you so that your life becomes an echo of my own, your chest corrupted by heartache as mine once was by the orb.

I hope and pray it is not the case - that in the time since I left you, you have lived a life full of beauty, happiness, and wonder. That is what I will picture when the time comes. Only you. You were all I ever needed.

You are calling to me - I have truly run out of time. But you will not - that I promise. When this is over, your life begins anew. Treasure it, as I treasured you. That is all I ask.

Yours forever,

Gale
Ch'r'ai Tska'an
*Mizora responds with knowing silence - and a wide smile.*
No matter how far away I may be, the Gate will always be first in my heart.
Yes?
Exactly the reaction I expected, my love.
I've got my own private wine cellar now - I'll keep a special vintage aside for your visit.
Nor are you the same woman who fell for me. Time can be unkind to hearts in that sense, especially if you fear change.
Well of course you did, my sweet. Who wouldn't miss such esteemed company?
I suppose you're right - he's come a long way since he first wandered into our camp. We all have.
Well I've been enjoying parties, plots, and plenty of hedonism. Nothing that would surprise you, really.
But you stoked new fires in me. The Blade of Avernus is now the ranger he was destined to be.
You're right, I was truly heroic.
I could say the same of you. Prospering at your lady's side, I take it?
As far as I'm concerned, you're always on the precipice of making your next terrible decision, sir. I won't be caught unawares again!
You really are a horrible person.
I made my choice for the good of Faerûn and beyond. I don't regret it.
The Blade of Frontiers is back on the hunt. The Sword Coast is safe as ever.
Lady Shar's blessings be upon you.
Confusion Ray
But nothing has made me quiver more than seeing your face here today, tentacles and all.
I heard rumours the Upper City was destroyed beyond reconstruction.
Of course. Be sure to kick the mud from your boots before returning, then. But while you're here among the mortals, why not enjoy it?
*Cutting through the dreadful buzz of the wasps and the screams of the damned, a familiar, comforting voice echoed in your mind - Withers.*
Lacey Garb
|Hand over the crown, now.|
Gnarled Tree Branch
Although I understand traversing a cosmic war zone is no easy thing.
And I did promise the children I would bring them back a surprise... imagine their faces.
I've been in the Hells with Karlach, fighting off devils and looking for a cure for her heart.
*... before giving your dragon the command. Fly!*
I relinquished the Crown of Karsus to Mystra and joined her on the plane of Elysium.
I won't forget that in a hurry - which is truly saying something, coming from me.
Can't get enough? I'm not surprised.
Visit Mod.io
Live... MUST...
You're still as rude as ever.
Well, sorry to spoil the fun - but it seems Minsc has landed himself in a Zhentarim cell.
<LSTag Type="Title">[1]</LSTag>
*She always listens, and she always replies, leading you to new adventures and enlightenment.*
I returned to Waterdeep a better wizard than I left it. Now, I read, I write, I do a spot of teaching...
You would merely slow me down.
If I must.
That's life, I'm afraid. We can't go back.
I could say the same - I haven't seen you walking the streets recently.
I knew an Evereskan Graycloak who would say 'Baldur's Gate will be the death of me, but I can't say it doesn't hold all of life.'
We were unable to send your report. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
| Campaign started |
Now we're talking.
I thought I would... but in truth, no. Roaming has lost its lustre now that I have somewhere I truly belong.
My love, my Shadowheart. To think there was a time when we were at each others' throats.
*The Blade.*
Now go on, the night's young. You shouldn't waste a moment of it.
The day is young, and there are thousands more days ahead of us.
Moustache C
Something's nagging at me. Could be a trap. The sort Zariel likes to set.
*The victory that enabled the war against Vlaakith's tyranny. You cannot be there in person, but you shall be there nonetheless.*
No, no, I prefer the warmth of my library's hearth these days. But the feeling of adventure... I confess - that I long for.
I could not leave my people at Vlaakith's mercy.
Forest trees draped in moss. Bittersweet, smoky - and that faintest hint of vanilla.
You ought to come visit myself and Gale when you're able. If you can extract yourself from what I'm sure are very important responsibilities.
Enabling is optional.
You enjoy travel and adventure, but miss Waterdeep whenever you are away. This is because your mind is restless, and can only find peace in familiar places.
*The creature mourns. You have brought pain - and you will pay.*
I'm quite happy with the status quo. Enjoy your evening, and don't talk about bark and moss too much.
I know, I would've been an open book to you in no time. But don't pretend like you didn't like the mystery.
And you - you've been making friends behind my back. What exactly have you signed us up to?
I told thee once that an illithid hath no soul, and yet... something glimmerest about thee. Something is not lost.
Almost a shame we didn't throw more parties, come to think of it. After felling Ketheric Thorm perhaps? We even had an inn at our disposal. And a brewery...
Show All (Unseen tutorials may contain spoilers!)
I've indulged in the odd spot of magical mischief. Nothing cataclysmic though - I assure you.
Some things are worth remembering. Celebrating, even.
Either way, the city's future is assured. I will make it my home, and in time, Waterdeep, Neverwinter and the rest... they will be my vassals.
She was just the distraction I needed. She nipped at the minion's heels and I leapt from its grasp, unsheathed my shortswords, and rushed at the amnizu in a fury.
Nature's servant... enjoys light revelry.
*You hurl your plea as a javelin into realms of unbounded darkness, but it misses its mark. No response.*
Gotcha, gotcha. Your secrets are safe with me...
Every target she's set me on's been a demonic intruder - tanar'ri assassins who slip into Avernus, armanites that amass near the Styx.
You are more than welcome to join our fight.
I'm not sure. Happy to be alive, I guess.
Now I'm cured, I'm just like any old Baldurian. Nothing special, and glad of it.
Know this: her courage never faltered, her soul never waned. She accomplished all she e'er sought out.
You are stalwart, even in service of darkness. There will be a lesson there for me to impart to the children... with a few details glossed over, perhaps. Thank you.
I like to import my food. Chult, Amn, Waterdeep, the Moonshae Isles - they all produce fine stock.
I was afraid to so much as dream of a night like this. To hope that my life might amount to more than lonely, bitter disappointment. And then I found you.
Looking Up
I was not asking for it. Htak'a!
Something the matter?
And the dining table. And the hearth. And above all, your lap.
I am Wyll Ravengard, son of Ulder!
Good. Had you challenged Mystra directly, you'd have been destroyed - Crown or no Crown.
Well met, young Ravengard. May your blade strike true more often than not.
I promise - I won't be gone forever. I miss my library, my mother, and you of course.
Gale returned to Waterdeep to pursue the scholarly arts.
Karsite Grip
Ambition is your bread and bloody butter.
What have you been up to?
Accept your calling. Become the Emperor's sword arm, and lead his nascent legions across Faerûn and beyond.
You bear your burdens with grace.
It's curious. After all the wonders and monstrosities we've witnessed, waking beside you seems more unreal than any of it.
*This is but the first conquest. Every realm shall quake at your power. Every tongue shall speak your name in awe. Every god shall perish in your shadow. This world is yours. Now for the rest.*
Good song, good company, good wine. I wish it could last forever.
If thou could only see the paths of fate untaken, thy mind would surely break. Be glad of thy chosen path. It is, after all, thine.
Dependencies: [1]
Rickety Chair
Better than some foes I've left in my wake, at least - the Blade's been busy.
We tracked it from the moment the Astral Prism fell into its claws.
The Blade of Avernus. Zhak vo'n'fynh duj.
Gale is the true saviour. Though I can't help but wonder if there wasn't another way...
But mere survival was not enough for you.
Come here. I want another hug.
Dead'zel
As for the Avernus crew... man, that place is brutal.
I'm proud of you. Always was.
You seem to be faring well without your warlock powers.
*Long did you live in your famed father's shadow. Long did you toil thanklessly for the common people. But now, you know true power. The Sword Coast is yours to command - and the many lands beyond.*
Fungal Infestation
Avoiding you like the plague, Mr Ravengard. Zariel's got her sights set on me. I don't want to drag you into my nonsense.
So do what you have to. You know where to find me when the mission's over.
Yes. She is not a patron I ever expected to have watching over me... but I am glad for her guidance.
Ah, the material plane. I'd almost forgotten what it's like.
You're no longer the same woman I fell for, are you?
Stars
And what mark have you been making, Minthara?
Not the sweet honeysuckle, the heady jasmine? Oh, but what does it matter?
Sorry, wiz, I'm going back to Avernus after the party.
1st Place Trophy
You are in good spirits tonight. Partnered life suits you, I presume.
Can I play along with you?
*Darkness once more swallows Astarion - but you will find him again, as you always do.*
Sweet cub. Rest up, and you can come with me in the morning, if you like?
Hm. Perhaps I've not sufficiently explained my - ah, predicament.
I am wounded.
Only so many criminals stalk the Undercity. I need more food, Wyll.
Purple Tie
I can catch everyone up on my infernal endeavours.
|Just try to not do anything too evil.|
That's everything. Goodbye, not-quite-Gale.
She grants me her divine power, yes. At times I wonder if I am truly deserving of them.
All a bit airy fairy for a woman with a devil on her scent. Thanks anyway.
I wager not. Well, probably for the best - I can smell only the sweet honeysuckle in the air. Karlach insists I reek with the blood of a hundred devils.
Hah! Forgive me - I am simply excitable. It is good to be out under an open sky once more.
Pray to you? Chk.
I'll come back to you. I promise.
You need not thank me for advice.
Perhaps that's a good thing. I'm sure they're far better students than I was...
An odd, but meticulous organisational system orders these ancient tomes.
Embrace her.
Do what you want. Don't expect me to applaud you when it's over.
In fact, when I pass them in the street, they wish me 'good day' and 'good fortune'.
To protect the Coast from hellspawn is my only ambition. And to that end, I need no god to guide me.
|Digging through the pontar was not ideal, but a small inconvenience in the grand scheme of things.|
Your affection is the only thing that matters.
Part of me was relieved you left so quickly after the battle. I felt... ashamed. Like I'd lost everything, just as you claimed your victory. I didn't want you to see me like that.
Provides an optimised balance of performance and image quality.
Provides the highest image quality, equal or superior to native rendering, with a minor performance gain.
I'm sorry, I wish I'd made a different choice.
Writhing Current
*He requested your attendance in Faerun - a chance to reflect on your triumph over the Absolute.*
